title: Transparency as precision: the active inference reading

statements.text: Limanowski and Friston carry the theory into active inference: transparency is the default mode in which conscious experience is presented, and opacity arises when the precision that underwrites introspective attention renders the evidence opaque. On this reading the necessary transparency of minimal self-representation follows from the architecture of the model, which limits self-modeling without an infinite regress.

sources.quote: We propose a relationship of phenomenal opacity to expected uncertainty or precision
taking transparency as the default presentation mode of conscious experience
